# nexspence_privilege (Resource)

A content-selector-scoped privilege (type repository-content-selector).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nexspence_privilege" "team_a_rw" {
  name             = "team-a-rw"
  description      = "Access scoped by the team-a content selector"
  content_selector = nexspence_content_selector.team_a.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content_selector` (String) Name of the content selector this privilege grants access through.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
